Resolutions of 1984

14 resolutions, 50% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 546 (1984) South Africa's military attacks on Angola
  • 547 (1984) Death sentence imposed on Malesela Benjamin Moloise
  • 548 (1984) Admission of Brunei Darussalam to membership in the United Nations
  • 549 (1984) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 550 (1984) Secessionist actions in Cyprus
  • 551 (1984) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 552 (1984) Attacks on commercial ships in the Gulf region
  • 553 (1984) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
  • 554 (1984) The "new constitution" of South Africa
  • 555 (1984) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 556 (1984) Demanding the immediate eradication of apartheid
  • 557 (1984) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 558 (1984) Arms embargo against South Africa
  • 559 (1984) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
